title: India-US-Quad pledge to expand cooperation to combat terrorism
description: India and US, along with Quad members, are working together to fight terrorism. In a meeting in Delhi, they condemned all forms of terrorism, including cross-border attacks, and discussed ways to enhance cooperation. Measures like asset freeze and arms embargo against Pakistan-based terror groups were also discussed.

title: India, US call for UN action against Pak terror units
description: India and the US urged the UN for sanctions against Pakistan-based terror groups, emphasizing cooperation in counter-terrorism and condemning recent attacks. | India News

title: India, US seek asset freeze of LeT, JeM
description: NEW DELHI, Dec 6: India and the US have sought additional punitive measures like asset freeze and arms embargo by the UN against Pakistan-based terror outfits Lashkar-e-Toiba and Jaish-e-Mohammad, their proxy groups and backers. The two sides also called for additional designations of ISIS and al-Qaeda affiliates. These terror groups were designated by the UN and they have already been facing various punitive actions under the global body’s sanctions regime. title: India, US Seek Additional Punitive Measures Against LeT, JeM And Their Backers
description: India and the US have sought additional punitive measures like asset freeze and arms embargo by the UN against Pakistan-based terror outfits Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammad, their proxy groups and backers. The two sides also called for additional designations of ISIS and al-Qa'ida affiliates. These terror groups were designated by the UN and they have already been facing various punitive actions under the global body's sanctions regime.

title: Hugh Grant Says He May Be 'Half Indian'; Reveals His Father Was Born In Undivided India
description: Hugh Grant surprised audiences at the HT Leadership Summit by revealing that his father was born in undivided India — possibly in a region that now lies in Pakistan. The actor said this connection “might make me half Indian,” while fondly recalling his early experiences filming in Kolkata.

title: India and US Strengthen Anti-Terrorism Allyship
description: India and the US have proposed UN sanctions against Pakistan-based terror groups, seeking asset freezes and arms embargoes. They aim to fortify bilateral and multilateral ties to combat terrorism, including stricter designations for ISIS and al-Qa'ida affiliates. Both nations emphasize unwavering cooperation in confronting terrorism globally.

title: Hugh Grant's Heritage: A Journey Through India and Beyond
description: Hugh Grant, celebrated British actor, humorously claims to be 'half Indian' due to his father's obscure northern Indian birthplace, possibly now in Pakistan. Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, Grant reflects on his career, including a memorable 1988 film shoot in Kolkata and experiences with the Merchant Ivory film production duo.
